subject: website
name: Victor42
summary: Victor42's Chinese-language Hugo blog. It stays at Level 2: its pages carry Google Tag Manager (gtag.js) loading code that runs on the victor42.eth.limo address, third-party analytics code the visitor has not asked for. It also loads Lato from Google Fonts. Its images come from cdn.victor42.work.

connections.name: Google Tag Manager (googletagmanager.com)
connections.note: gtag.js injected by an inline script on every page when the host is victor42.eth.limo; no integrity hash. Not seen in the headless probe.

connections.name: Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com)
connections.note: Lato stylesheet fetched when the page opens.

connections.name: Site image host (cdn.victor42.work)
connections.note: Post images and favicon fetched when the page opens.
